scope: Real Windows installed-app checks with fixture provider replies, injected blank/missing captures, and emitted lock/suspend signals. No real AI inference or paid calls.

cases.name: first launch stays inactive; real encrypted key save and verification retry
detection-only session records fixture matches without covers
fullscreen test window is covered; native bounds/topmost/focus and button recovery
native close dismisses covers and pauses rather than trapping the desktop
real Windows emergency keyboard shortcut releases the blocking cover
lock and suspend signals release covers
HTTP failure, offline connection and malformed replies pause with no automatic retry
pause aborts a pending request and a real timeout does not retry
blank and unavailable capture fail before any provider request
budget blocks network requests; preferences/key/usage survive restart without auto-start
corrupted budget history refuses protection without resetting spend or sending requests

unit_tests.note: Linux-only platform refusal check skipped on Windows
